name: Pines — 39 landscape-forming species
notes: Kew accepts ~115 pines; these are the ones that make forests: boreal, Mediterranean, Himalayan, Chinese and Japanese, western and eastern North American, Mexican and Caribbean. Wind-pollinated; seeds by wind and by nutcrackers/jays (whitebark, Swiss stone, pinyon depend on birds). Many are fire species: lodgepole and jack pine reseed a burn in even-aged stands; longleaf and ponderosa need fire to keep their savanna open — the disturbance phase should read that.
